round_note: Amazon's Black Friday Week runs Nov 19-30, and early deals are already live: smart plugs, winter skincare and bedding at big discounts, plus stocking stuffers.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and one of Amazon's most-gifted devices every holiday season.

picks.name: Apple AirTag (2nd Generation)
picks.why: Track keys, luggage or a pet from your iPhone. Amazon's Black Friday sale has it at one of its lowest single-unit prices yet.

picks.name: Kasa Smart Plug Mini (4-Pack)
picks.why: Four small Wi-Fi plugs that put lamps and holiday lights on a schedule or voice control. One of this week's most popular smart-home markdowns.

picks.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Mascara Gift Set
picks.why: Three mini Lash Sensational mascaras in a holiday box. An inexpensive stocking stuffer from a drugstore best seller.
picks.query: Maybelline Lash Sensational mascara holiday gift set

picks.name: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Balm B5
picks.why: A soothing, multi-purpose balm for dry, chapped winter skin. A dermatologist favorite that's on sale in Amazon's early Black Friday deals.

picks.name: PAVOI 14K Gold Plated Love Knot Studs
picks.why: Simple knotted stud earrings from one of Amazon's most popular jewelry brands. An affordable gift that looks more expensive.
picks.query: PAVOI 14K gold plated love knot stud earrings

picks.name: adidas Athletic Crew Socks (6 Pairs)
picks.why: A six-pack of cushioned, moisture-wicking crew socks. A classic stocking stuffer, and marked down again for Black Friday.
picks.query: adidas athletic cushioned crew socks 6 pairs

picks.name: Hanes EcoSmart Crewneck Sweatshirt
picks.why: A soft fleece pullover close to its lowest price ever. A cheap, reliable layer for colder weather.
picks.query: Hanes Men's EcoSmart Fleece Crewneck Sweatshirt

picks.name: Eddie Bauer Plush Throw Blanket
picks.why: A large, two-sided plush throw that's more than half off right now. An easy, cozy holiday gift for almost anyone.
picks.query: Eddie Bauer ultra plush throw blanket

picks.name: Utopia Bedding Microfiber Sheet Set
picks.why: A soft, budget-friendly sheet set in lots of colors, and one of the deepest percentage discounts in Amazon's early Black Friday deals.
picks.query: Utopia Bedding queen sheet set microfiber

picks.name: DASH Mini Waffle Maker
picks.why: A palm-size waffle maker in lots of colors, and a perennial Amazon kitchen best seller. A fun, inexpensive gift that keeps showing up on holiday gift lists.

picks.name: YETI Rambler 16 oz Travel Bottle
picks.why: A leakproof insulated travel bottle that keeps coffee hot on the commute, discounted in Amazon's Black Friday sale.

picks.name: Bocce's Bakery Dog Advent Calendar
picks.why: Twelve days of all-natural dog treats. A fun way to include the dog in the holiday countdown.
picks.query: Bocce's Bakery 12 day advent calendar for dogs

picks.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
picks.why: A build-a-day Star Wars countdown to Christmas, and one of the best-priced LEGO advent calendars this season.

picks.name: Squishmallows Disney Pajama Stitch
picks.why: A 10-inch Stitch Squishmallow in pajamas. Plush toys like this are among the most-requested kids' gifts this season.
picks.query: Squishmallows Disney Pajama Stitch HugMees 10 inch

picks.name: Murdle: Volume 1
picks.why: A best-selling book of murder-mystery logic puzzles that get harder as you go. A clever gift for puzzle lovers and white elephant swaps.
